description: Each route picks its own strategy (SSG, ISR, SSR, client rendering) inside one app and one framework.
Time to first byte. Lowest from a CDN (static, SSG, ISR hits), higher when the server renders per request.
Largest Contentful Paint. Good when the main content is in the initial HTML; poor when it waits for a bundle and a client fetch.
Interaction to Next Paint. Hurt by long main-thread work such as hydrating a large tree; improved by shipping less JavaScript.
CPU and download time to re-run components in the browser so server HTML becomes interactive. Grows with the size of the hydrated tree.
A shared, cacheable page with personal or live parts fetched on the client or streamed separately (Partial Prerendering, server islands).
